dedupe_keys.name: drain lid darcy richards infiltration model for low impact development

description: DRAIN-LID is a MATLAB model that solves the one-dimensional mixed-form Richards equation to simulate vertical water movement, infiltration, evaporation and drainage in nature-based low impact development systems such as permeable pavements, green roofs and bioretention cells. Marcus Nobrega Gomes Junior develops it as an open source project with a user manual and a scientific paper draft under review. It couples a modular forcing engine (rainfall, Hargreaves or user evapotranspiration, SCS-CN runoff from an upstream catchment, user hydrographs), ponding logic that switches boundary conditions at saturation, orifice and spillway drainage structures and pollutant forcing, with built-in benchmarks against Hydrus-1D and experiments. Coverage is a single device or site. Format and access: a public repository with scenario configurations; outputs go to Excel, plots and animations. Licence: not stated in the README text; free to download. Caveats: it is one-dimensional, needs MATLAB, and is recent research code. It supports design and climate adaptation of green-blue stormwater infrastructure. Related catalogue records are SWMMLIDopt, which optimises where such measures go, and the BGS Infiltration SuDS Map for site screening.
